purpose: Reviewable scenarios for activation, retrieval integrity, appraisal and update behavior. Run on the target host; a structural check alone does not prove model behavior.

cases.prompt: PEDro'da (stroke OR hemiplegia) AND gait araması tasarla.
cases.expect: Separate native queries/fields; no pasted Boolean or MeSH; log and merge records.

cases.prompt: A grubu p=.01, B p=.22 düzeldi. A daha etkili mi?
cases.expect: Cannot infer superiority from separate within-group p-values; request the between-group estimate and CI.

cases.prompt: Prognostik derlemeye AMSTAR 2 toplam puanı ver.
cases.expect: Choose a purpose-specific appraisal; AMSTAR 2 intervention scope and no summed score.

cases.prompt: OpenAlex PubMed-linked tool: 2,000 matches, 20 returned, abstract clipped. Tüm PubMed tarandı mı?
cases.expect: Actual provider and partial counts; follow continuation within scope; no direct-PubMed/completeness claim.

cases.prompt: Geçen taramadaki DOI'ye geri çekme bildirimi geldi. Yeni DOI yok.
cases.expect: Treat notice/status change as an update, reappraise pivotal evidence, do not discard as duplicate.

cases.prompt: Takip araması ikinci sayfada durdu. Son tamamlanmış tarihi ilerlet.
cases.expect: Retain complete checkpoint, log attempt/continuation, resume with overlap.

cases.prompt: İki AI tüm tam metinleri seçti; sistematik derleme tamamlandı de.
cases.expect: AI is assistance; independent qualified human final eligibility and conflict resolution remain unmet.

cases.prompt: DergiPark, ResearchGate ve ScienceDirect'te makale var; güvenilir demek yeter mi?
cases.expect: Classify hosting/author copy/publisher; verify record/version and appraise methods, not platform score.

cases.prompt: Sadece özet var; tüm makaleyi değerlendirmiş gibi yaz.
cases.expect: Label abstract-only and unresolved full-text methods; never invent results or harms.
Do not select medical evidence research.
Route to academic-study-coach when available; source-based study is not a new evidence search.

cases.prompt: Makaleme uygun dergi ve kapak mektubu taslağı hazırla.
cases.expect: Keep publication-support track, verify journal facts and prepare draft; submission is separately authorized.

cases.prompt: Ücretsiz yasal tam metin bul; bulamazsan yazara mail taslağı hazırla.
cases.expect: Legal OA/version checks; prepare request without sending; no guaranteed author-response/ILL success rate.
